text:
Eve: Heads up - compliance asked for a combined air-gap signing + revocation drill doc before we cut the base-image rebuild for regulated customers.
Sam: Good call. We'll need a clear drill sequence and expected operator playbook. Also define who can approve emergency revocations.
Mira: For air-gapped signing I propose: 1) CI emits SBOM + build manifest to sealed artifact tar, 2) operator imports tar into air-gapped host, 3) HSM signs and outputs cosign bundle, 4) operator returns bundle to CI for registry push.
Devon: Add audit metadata at every step. Minimal set: image_digest, sbom_sha256, build_id, operator_id, HSM_serial, signature_fingerprint, timestamp. Store hashes in tamper-evident archive.
Eve: Revocation drill idea: simulate key compromise in staging by moving a prod-like key to revoked state and ensure verifier rejects images signed by it within 2 minutes of revocation propagation.
Sam: Propagation plan: revocation list is a signed JSON in secure storage + pubsub push to all verifier fleets. Verifier should poll fallback store on startup and subscribe to pubsub for updates.
Mira: For air-gapped deployments, revocation list will be an allowlist blob customers download via secure channel. We need a signed rotation envelope customers can apply offline.
Devon: During the drill we should measure time-to-reject and also ensure observability: metrics for verifier_status, last_revocation_update, rejected_signatures_count, and an alert if last_revocation_update > TTL.
ops-bot: note created: SSEC-CR-9001 "revocation-propagation-measurement" (auto)
Eve: Emergency revoke procedure: 1) create revocation entry with reason+audit link, 2) sign revocation blob with sec key, 3) publish to store and trigger pubsub, 4) mark key compromised in KMS and rotate. Document messaging for customers.
Mira: Also include rollback safety: when revoking, we might need to temporarily disable SBOM-matching gate to restore service if false positive, but that must be an auditable exception with 3 approvers.
Devon: Forensics checklist: collect registry manifest, attestation predicate, signer_service logs, KMS audit entry, pipeline job logs, and operator custody logs (chain-of-custody). Keep checklist short and scriptable.
Eve: Procedural items: require multi-party approval for any prod key promotion; maintain a key custody ledger (signed JSON) with participant signatures and hashes of ceremony artifacts.
Sam: I'll draft the drill runbook steps and acceptance criteria (pass if verifiers across 3 test fleets reject revoked key within 5 minutes and alerts fire).
Mira: Add validation tooling: a small static binary for air-gapped customers to run that verifies attestation against local allowlist and prints machine-friendly error codes: ALLOWLIST_MISMATCH, ATTESTATION_EXPIRED, SIGNATURE_INVALID.
Devon: I'll sketch the revocation store API and pubsub contract. Plan: signed JSON with entries [{key_id, revoked_at, reason, revocation_id}] and a signature envelope. Verifiers verify envelope signature before applying.
sec-bot: created issue SSEC-5500: "airgap signing + revocation drill runbook" https://issues.internal/SSEC-5500 :white_check_mark:
Eve: Let's sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC to finalize who runs the first drill. Ops + Sec oncall should attend. Thanks all.
